visualCharacteristics.purpose: Quick-links band: a row of small circular icons, each beside a short linked label
visualCharacteristics.layout: Items centered in one row (wrapping on small screens); icon left of a two-line label

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: icon image; cell 2: link whose text is the label (e.g. 'Download Templates'). The icon becomes part of the same link

usage: Utility/quick-access links (downloads, catalogs, contact) in a light band.
reuseGuidance: Use for short icon + label links. For image cards with a description use cards-solutions or cards.
